name: A0 MoonBoard / flow map and decisions
note: Start here.

name: A0 Dock / anatomy, states and motion
note: Reference: beui.dev motion dock.

name: A1 Shell / Home with dock
note: Dock replaces the single stack. Next up keeps one-tap Start; the board card resumes the last problem.

name: A2 Shell / Hang tab
note: Workout library moves off Home into its own tab.

name: A3 Shell / Log tab
note: Heat calendar after beui.dev: 16 weeks, one hue, darker means more training time. Cells arrive in a diagonal wave; reduced motion fades them in.

name: A4 Shell / Settings
note: Sound, vibration and Gen Z mode stay in the timer menu too.

name: A5 Shell / Log, a day pinned
note: Tap a day to pin it: the others dim and its sessions show below. The squares are small, so a finger can also slide across the grid and the pin follows it. Tap the pinned day, or Clear, to let go.

name: B1 Setup / Climb tab before a board
note: First visit. Nothing is asked for until the climber chooses to set up.

name: B2 Setup / choose the board
note: Benchmark counts are real for the late-2023 list.

name: B3 Setup / angle
note: Only asked when the layout exists at two angles.

name: B4 Setup / hold sets
note: Problems that need a missing set are hidden, never greyed out.

name: B5 Setup / lights or not
note: Lights are optional. The whole problem library works without them.

name: C1 Connect / before the permission
note: The system Bluetooth prompt follows Continue. It is never shown at launch.

name: C2 Connect / searching
note: Rings pulse outwards every 1.6 s; reduced motion shows a static state with the text.

name: C3 Connect / boards found
note: Strongest signal first. A single board connects on its own after 1 s unless the list is touched.

name: C4 Connect / check the lights
note: One glance proves orientation and wiring before the first problem.

name: C5 Connect / lights look wrong
note: Each answer applies a fix and re-runs the corner test.

name: C6 Connect / connected
note: The box has no brightness control. The only light option is the above-hold flag (V2 kits and newer).

name: C7 Connect / Bluetooth is off
note: Detected before scanning; the screen leaves on its own once Bluetooth is on.

name: C8 Connect / permission blocked
note: Shown after a denied system prompt. Never nags again on its own.

name: C9 Connect / no board found
note: Timeout state with the three checks that fix most cases.

name: C10 Connect / lights sheet
note: Opened from the lights chip on the Climb tab.

name: D1 Climb / problem list
note: The Climb tab. Board switcher top left, lights chip top right, the wall thumbnail on every row.

name: D2 Climb / filters
note: The histogram is the real grade spread; the button always states the result count.

name: D3 Climb / nothing matches
note: An empty result explains why and offers the shortest way out.

name: D4 Climb / problem
note: Swipe left or right for the next problem in the list. Without lights, Light up opens the connect flow.

name: D5 Climb / lit on the wall
note: Screen stays awake while lit. Swiping relights the wall only when Light as I browse is on, so browsing never changes what someone is climbing.

name: D6 Climb / lights dropped
note: Losing the lights never blocks logging. The app retries quietly for 30 s.

name: D7 Climb / log a send
note: Three taps at most. Tries are prefilled from the counter; everything else is optional.

name: D8 Climb / sent
note: Your own history on the problem, then straight on to the next one.

name: E1 Create / set a problem
note: Pick a role, tap holds. With lights on, the wall mirrors every tap. Capped at 30 holds: the box cuts off longer messages.

name: E2 Create / name and grade
note: Only a name is required. Grade can stay open as a project.

name: E3 Create / my problems
note: Own problems live beside the benchmarks and share as a QR code, like workouts.

name: E4 Create / share as QR
note: Same offline QR pattern as workouts: no text to copy, no link, no server.

name: E5 Log / board session
note: A board session opens at the first lit or logged problem and closes after 30 quiet minutes.

name: E6 Settings / your MoonBoard
note: Changing the setup never deletes the log; sends stay tied to the layout they were climbed on.

name: F1 Circuits / your circuits
note: A circuit is a playlist: problems climbed in a fixed order. Start is one tap.

name: F2 Circuits / one circuit
note: Order matters, so rows are numbered.

name: F3 Circuits / add a problem
note: From the list icon on any problem. A problem can sit in several circuits.

name: F4 Circuits / edit and reorder
note: Same drag-to-reorder as the workout builder. Removing a problem only takes it out of this circuit.

name: F5 Circuits / climbing a circuit
note: Sent it or Skip moves straight to the next problem and lights it: starting a circuit is the consent to change the wall. No timer, no rests.

name: F6 Circuits / done
note: Saved as a board session the moment the last problem ends, like a workout.
